title: Scheduled date saved one day early
what_is_wrong: The schedule date shown in a sent request is one day earlier than the date picked (Nov 15 shown for a Nov 16 pick).
why_it_is_a_bug: The firm is shown the wrong send date — it reads as already past — even though the backend still fires the email at the correct time.
technical_detail: Display-only bug: scheduleDate field reads Nov 15 after picking Nov 16; the actual scheduled email still fired on time (verified in maildrop at ~the real slot).
steps: Log in to Cone.
In a project, Create task > Client request > Ask a question > Continue.
Set due date Nov 16; choose Schedule for later.
Pick Nov 16 and 3:10 PM, click Schedule.
Reopen the request and read Schedule date.
should_happen: Schedule date stays Nov 16 3:10 PM.
actually_happens: Schedule date displays Nov 15 3:10 PM — one day before what was picked.

title: Schedule-for-later defaults past the due date
what_is_wrong: Choosing Schedule for later pre-fills the next day at 02:30 AM, which is later than the request's own due date.
why_it_is_a_bug: A request due Nov 16 defaults to being emailed Nov 17 — the client is asked for something after it is already due, and nothing warns the firm.
technical_detail: scheduleDate defaults to tomorrow; schedule time always 02:30 AM; no validation against dueDate.
steps: Log in to Cone.
Create task > Client request > any type.
Set Due date to today.
Click Schedule for later and read the prefilled date/time.
should_happen: Default schedule is before the due date, or a warning appears.
actually_happens: Defaults to tomorrow 02:30 AM — after the due date — with no warning.

title: Draft save says 'Task created'
what_is_wrong: Clicking Save as draft shows the toast 'Task created'.
why_it_is_a_bug: The toast claims the task was created/sent when it was only saved as a draft — misleading about what happened.
technical_detail: Same 'Task created' toast as a real send; draft appears in the task list.
steps: Log in to Cone.
Create task > Client request > Ask a question > Continue.
Type a title, click Save as draft.
Watch the toast.
should_happen: Toast says the draft was saved.
actually_happens: Toast says 'Task created'.

title: 'Send reminder email' button always disabled
what_is_wrong: On a sent, waiting-on-client request the 'Send reminder email' button in the banner is greyed out and can never be clicked.
why_it_is_a_bug: The only visible way to nudge a client manually is dead on every sent request — regardless of whether auto reminders were on or off when sending.
technical_detail: Button disabled on requests sent with reminders ON and on 'S1 PB13 norem' sent with reminders OFF. Share > 'Resend request via email' does work ('Email sent' toast).
steps: Log in to Cone.
Create and send a client request (any type), then reopen it from the task list.
In the 'Waiting on client' banner, try to click 'Send reminder email'.
Repeat with a request sent with client reminders turned OFF — same result.
should_happen: The firm can send a reminder manually on a waiting request.
actually_happens: The button stays disabled in every case; only Share > Resend request via email works.

title: Can't log time on a completed task
what_is_wrong: Completed tasks do not appear in the Add time entry task picker, so no time can ever be logged on them.
why_it_is_a_bug: Time must often be logged after work is finished (forgotten timer). Hiding completed tasks makes that impossible; open and completed tasks should both be selectable.
technical_detail: Picker search 'DESC' returns only open 'S1 A1 desconly'; 'EMPTY' returns 'No result found' though 'S1 req EMPTY' and 'S1 req DESC' (Completed) exist in S1 alpha one-time.
steps: Log in to Cone.
Work > Time entries > Add time entry.
Open the task picker and search a completed task's name (e.g. 'DESC' or 'EMPTY').
should_happen: Completed tasks appear in the picker and can be selected for a manual entry.
actually_happens: Completed tasks never appear; exact-name search returns 'No result found'.

title: Escape does not close the client-portal PDF viewer
what_is_wrong: In the client portal, opening a shared PDF from a task shows a viewer dialog. Pressing Escape does nothing — the client must find and click the X button to get back to the task.
why_it_is_a_bug: Every other dialog in the portal closes on Escape; the PDF viewer silently ignores it, so the client can get stuck on a document with no obvious way back.
steps: Send a Share-documents client request with a PDF attached
Client portal: Tasks → open the task → click the PDF file name
PDF viewer opens showing the document
Press Escape
Viewer stays open; only the X (Close) button closes it
should_happen: Escape closes the viewer and returns to the task, like every other dialog in the portal.
actually_happens: Escape does nothing; the PDF viewer stays open.

title: E-sign request: checklist items vanish from the firm drawer after client signs
what_is_wrong: After the client ticks the checklist items, signs and submits an e-sign request, the firm's request drawer sometimes shows a bare 'Checklist' heading with no items — the items are gone even though the list row still reads 2/2.
why_it_is_a_bug: The firm can no longer see what the client was asked to check off — the checklist content is lost from the firm view right after the request completes.
technical_detail: Intermittent. Try 1: drawer showed 'Checklist' heading with zero items while the list badge stayed 2/2 and the portal still showed the ticks. Try 2 (identical steps): items retained, badge 0/2. Looks like a rendering/state race when the request flips to 'Completed by client'.
steps: Create a client request: e-signature type, add a checklist with 2 items, attach a PDF, send.
In the client portal, tick both checklist items, sign the document (all signature fields), submit.
Back in Cone, open the request's task drawer.
Look at the Checklist section.
should_happen: The Checklist section still lists both items and their ticked state.
actually_happens: Try 1: Checklist heading shown but the item list is empty — items vanished (list row still shows 2/2). Try 2: items present but marked 0/2. Reproduced once out of two.

title: E-sign field setup drops every field on the same spot
what_is_wrong: When adding fields to a signature request, every new field is dropped at exactly the same coordinates (Signature at 206px,366px; Date at 246px,381px) instead of being offset, so fields stack invisibly on top of each other.
why_it_is_a_bug: The sender cannot see that multiple fields exist — they overlap perfectly — and must drag them apart one by one, which also makes it easy to leave hidden duplicate fields on the document.
technical_detail: Measured via getBoundingClientRect on the absolutely-positioned field elements: two Signature fields both at left 206 / top 366, Date field at 246 / 381. Identical coordinates on both tries.
steps: Create a client request of type e-signature and upload a PDF.
In the signature field setup, add a Signature field twice, then a Date field.
Look at where each field lands on the page.
should_happen: Each new field is offset (cascaded) so every field is visible.
actually_happens: All fields of the same type stack at identical coordinates — confirmed in both tries.

title: Task drawer closes and silently discards unsaved edits (bug 30 retest)
what_is_wrong: Editing a task's name in the drawer and then closing the drawer with X or clicking outside discards the edit without any warning.
why_it_is_a_bug: Users expect a 'discard unsaved changes' confirmation; silent data loss on close is a real workflow hazard.
steps: Open a task drawer
Change the task name without saving
Click X or click outside the drawer
Reopen: the edit is gone, no warning was shown
should_happen: A discard-confirmation or the change is preserved.
actually_happens: Silent discard, both tries.

title: Two tabs editing the same task silently overwrite each other
what_is_wrong: Opening the same task in two tabs and saving different edits: the last save wins and the other tab's change is gone with no conflict warning.
why_it_is_a_bug: Silent loss of edits when the same task is open in multiple tabs or for multiple people.
steps: Open the same task in two browser tabs
Edit a field in tab 1 and save
Edit the same field in tab 2 and save
Reload: only the last save survives
should_happen: A conflict warning or real-time sync between tabs.
actually_happens: Last-save-wins silently, both tries.

title: Sections inside a project cannot be reordered
what_is_wrong: Sections can be added and renamed but there is no way to reorder them: no drag handle, no menu option, no keyboard path.
why_it_is_a_bug: Workflow stages are usually ordered; teams cannot fix the column order without deleting and recreating sections.
steps: In a project with 3 sections, hover/drag the section header
Check the section menu for a move option
Try keyboard dragging
should_happen: A drag handle or a move up/down option reorders sections.
actually_happens: No reorder affordance exists, both tries.

title: Deleting a section silently deletes all its tasks (bug 17 retest)
what_is_wrong: Deleting a section that contains tasks deletes every task inside it without warning and without offering to move them.
why_it_is_a_bug: Destructive data loss with no confirmation about the tasks inside and no move/merge option.
steps: Create a section holding 2 tasks
Delete the section from its menu
Tasks are gone; no task-loss warning and no remap option
should_happen: Warn that N tasks will be deleted or offer to move them to another section.
actually_happens: Silent deletion of the tasks, both tries.

title: Project saves with due date earlier than start date (bug 9 retest)
what_is_wrong: Creating a project with due date before start date saves silently; the list then shows the due date as 'X days ago'.
why_it_is_a_bug: Impossible date ranges should be blocked or at least warned about.
steps: Create Project wizard
Set start Nov 16 and due Nov 10
Continue and create — it saves
should_happen: Validation error: due cannot be before start.
actually_happens: Saves silently, both tries.

title: An ended project cannot be reopened
what_is_wrong: After 'Mark as ended' the project has no Reopen/Reactivate option anywhere: row menu, project header menu, and Edit project have no path back.
why_it_is_a_bug: Ending by mistake is irreversible from the UI; the confirm dialog does not say it is permanent.
steps: End a project via 'Mark as ended' + Confirm
Check row menu, header menu and Edit project
No reopen option exists
should_happen: A Reopen action or editable status lets the project return to In progress.
actually_happens: No way back, both tries.

title: Task status list cannot be changed after project creation
what_is_wrong: In 'Edit project' the 'Task status list' combobox is disabled, so the status list chosen at creation is permanent. Client and owner do save.
why_it_is_a_bug: Teams evolve their workflows; being locked to the initial status list forces recreating the project.
steps: Open Edit project on an existing project
Try to change 'Task status list' — control is disabled
should_happen: The status list can be changed (with remapping for existing tasks).
actually_happens: The combobox is disabled, both tries.

title: Duplicating a project drops all sections and can stall mid-copy
what_is_wrong: The duplicate copies title/client/owner/dates/status-list and (eventually) tasks, but the section structure is lost: every task lands in 'Default'. Copying is async with no progress indicator; the first try stalled at 14 of 23 tasks for 7+ minutes.
why_it_is_a_bug: The copy silently loses organization and can silently lose tasks.
steps: Duplicate a project with 3 sections and 23 tasks
Open the copy: all tasks are flat in Default; sections gone
First attempt showed 0/14 for over 7 minutes
should_happen: The copy preserves sections and shows copy progress.
actually_happens: Sections dropped; copy async and flaky, both tries.

title: No archive option for projects
what_is_wrong: Projects offer Edit, Duplicate, Mark as ended, and Delete — but no Archive in either the list row menu or the project page header menu.
why_it_is_a_bug: There is no way to hide a finished project while keeping it editable; 'Ended' is irreversible (see ended-reopen bug) and Delete is permanent.
steps: Check the project row menu and the project header menu for Archive
should_happen: An Archive action hides the project while keeping it restorable.
actually_happens: No archive affordance exists, both tries.

title: Deleted project URL floods error toasts instead of 404 (bug 77 retest)
what_is_wrong: Visiting the URL of a deleted project renders a blank content shell while 'invalid project id' and 'unable to get tasks' error toasts stack endlessly. The earlier phantom page is gone but the failure mode is still broken.
why_it_is_a_bug: A dead link should show a single 'not found' state or redirect, not an error-toast flood.
steps: Delete a project
Navigate to its /pm/work/projects/details/<id>/tasks URL
Blank page + repeated error toasts
should_happen: 404 page or redirect to the projects list.
actually_happens: Blank shell + endless toast spam, both tries.

title: Whitespace-only names accepted on names across the app — produces unnamed rows/headers/statuses
what_is_wrong: Name fields accept whitespace-only input with no trimming or validation: a project can be saved with a blank name, a task created with a spaces-only name shows as a nameless row in the list, and a section renamed to spaces-only becomes a nameless section header. All persist after reload. Custom status names (Settings > Task statuses) also accept spaces-only input — a nameless status chip is saved and persists after reload. Separately, renaming a section to an existing name correctly fires 'unable to edit section' but briefly renders the duplicate header before reverting. Also affects email template names (a fully EMPTY name saves → nameless row) and form template names (spaces-only publishes → nameless row). Also affects: project template titles (spaces-only creates a nameless draft template), template task names (nameless task row), client company names (spaces-only saves over a real client name), and contact first/last names (spaces-only creates a nameless contact).
why_it_is_a_bug: Users can save items with no visible name — unnamed tasks and sections are confusing to identify, hard to distinguish, and an unnamed section header gives almost no click target to manage or rename it.
steps: Create or rename a project/task/section/custom status name to spaces only.
Save — it is accepted with no error.
Reload: the item remains but has no name anywhere it is displayed.
should_happen: Trim the input and reject empty/whitespace-only names with a clear validation message, on every name field.
actually_happens: Whitespace-only names save silently on project name, task name and section name; items appear nameless in every list and header.
explanation: Also affects email template names — a fully EMPTY name saves and renders a nameless row.

title: Cannot create folders on client A's Files — 'Failed to create folder' on every attempt
what_is_wrong: In S1 Chrome client A > Files > Cone storage, Add > New folder always fails with an 'Error adding folder / Failed to create folder' toast — at Home level and nested inside Client Uploads, for any name (short, long, plain). The identical steps succeed on S1 Chrome client B, so folder creation is broken on client A specifically; its 'Client Uploads' folder was created fine a day earlier. No reason for the failure is shown.
why_it_is_a_bug: Users cannot create any folder for this client — file organization for that client is completely blocked, and the error message gives no cause or remedy.
should_happen: The folder is created and appears in the file list.
actually_happens: A red toast 'Error adding folder / Failed to create folder' appears; no folder is created, on every attempt on client A.
steps: Client A > Files > Cone storage > Add > New folder > type any name (e.g. 'S2TX10 try2 folder') > Create folder. Repeat inside 'Client Uploads' — same failure. Same steps on client B succeed.

title: Drag & drop an image into a description editor does nothing
what_is_wrong: Dropping an image file onto the TipTap description editor inserts nothing — no upload, no placeholder, no error.
why_it_is_a_bug: The editor supports images (paste and Insert>Image both work), so users expect drag & drop to insert too; silently doing nothing is a broken affordance.
steps: 1. Open any description editor (e.g. an Ask a question client request). 2. Drag an image file from the file manager and drop it inside the editor. 3. Nothing happens — tried twice.
should_happen: The dropped image uploads and appears inline, exactly like pasting it.
actually_happens: The drop is ignored; no image is inserted.

title: K.5 not reproduced — typing into a collapsed description drops no letters
what_is_wrong: Previously reported: typing into the description before clicking could drop letters. In three clean tries every typed character arrived.
why_it_is_a_bug: Retest entry — kept for traceability; no defect observed this round. Adjacent a11y issue: Tab from the title focuses a toolbar button, not the description body.
steps: 1. Create/edit a request, single-click the collapsed description so it expands. 2. Type immediately. 3. All characters appear (2nd try recorded).
should_happen: Typing should land in the editor — it does.
actually_happens: Works correctly in this Chrome run; bug not reproduced.

title: Scheduled client request saves the date one day early — email never fires
what_is_wrong: Scheduling a client request for later saves the date one day EARLIER than the date picked in the calendar. Picked Nov 16 in the date picker; the saved banner and stored scheduleDate both show Nov 15. Confirmed on 3 separate requests (Ask a question, Upload documents, Share documents).
why_it_is_a_bug: The user picks a date and the app silently stores a different one. Because the stored date lands in the past, the scheduled email never fires and the request stays stuck as 'Scheduled' — 'Schedule for later' is effectively broken.
steps: 1. Create task > Client request > any type. 2. Fill title; keep 'Send client request email' ON. 3. Choose 'Schedule for later', pick today's date (Nov 16) + a time. 4. Click Schedule. 5. Open the task: banner says 'Scheduled Nov 15 ...' and the date field shows Nov 15.
should_happen: The saved schedule date equals the picked date, and the request email fires at that date/time.
actually_happens: Saved date is one day earlier (Nov 16 -> Nov 15). Stored date is already in the past, so the email never fires and the request stays Scheduled forever.

title: No way to create an email template during the send flow
what_is_wrong: While creating a client request, 'Customize email' opens a 'Task initial email template' dialog whose Template dropdown only lists existing templates (with a search box). There is no 'new template' or 'create template' option anywhere in the send flow.
why_it_is_a_bug: The test plan expects a template to be creatable mid-send and usable immediately; instead the user must leave the flow, go to Templates, create it, then come back.
steps: 1. Create task > Client request > any type. 2. Delivery settings > 'Customize email'. 3. Open the Template dropdown and search — only existing templates, no create option.
should_happen: A way to create a brand-new email template from the send flow and use it immediately.
actually_happens: Only existing templates can be picked; the dialog also notes 'Changes made here won't affect the email template being used' — so per-send edits can't even be saved as a template.

title: Cannot create a folder during the request send flow
what_is_wrong: In an upload-documents request, 'Where should clients upload documents? > Change' opens a folder picker that only lists existing folders (with a search box). No new-folder option exists anywhere in the dialog.
why_it_is_a_bug: The user must cancel the request, go create the folder elsewhere, then come back — the send flow can't stand alone.
steps: 1. Create task > Client request > Request to upload documents > Continue. 2. 'Where should clients upload documents?' > Change. 3. Picker shows only existing folders; no create option.
should_happen: A 'new folder' affordance in the picker so a destination can be created mid-send.
actually_happens: Only existing folders can be picked; search returns nothing to create.
